summary: The reconciler reads only as much of a subject's claim history as each decision needs: the newest or oldest claim that matches, whether one exists, or the claims after a point, instead of every claim of that kind; the profile names the kind and caller of each history read

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change. The new reads use the existing claims_subject_kind_accepted_index.

compatibility.detail: Every changed read returns the same claims, in the same canonical order, as the whole-history read it replaces, up to where its caller stops; decisions are unchanged. Under ST3_PROFILE_DIR, history reads appear in the profile as their SQL followed by `-- claims_for KIND at FILE:LINE` or `-- claims_in_order KIND at FILE:LINE`.

recovery.detail: An older build reads each whole history, as before.
